metadata.title: Clicked like a confused frog and somehow snagged that 1 unlucky soul? Valorant logic is wild
metadata.description:
Spam-clicking like I’m swatting a mosquito.
Enemy probably wondering if I hacked or just fluked.
Did NOT deserve that lucky shot but I’m cashing in on chaos.
If your aim’s a glorious mess, this one’s for you.

Tap if your aim’s a beautiful accident too!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
